DUNGEONS OF DOOM — first BASIC program

The Spectrum Show source has one original DungeonFinal.tzx containing two linked BASIC programs. We kept the original tape without changes. The first program has 68 numbered BASIC lines, recovered directly from the first tape block with the Spectrum ROM-based listing tool. Its job is to set up custom graphics and offer a symbol guide. It is a loader, not the active dungeon game.

The first program asks if we want a list of the graphic characters. We selected S, saw the graphics guide in Fuse 48K, pressed ENTER to return, and then selected N. The original tape loaded its second BASIC program and showed the next program starting. Four genuine Fuse captures record those steps. We did not use the printer choice or enter the active dungeon in this first-part replay. The printer has escaped with its dignity intact.

REPLAY.sh uses the original full TZX, Fuse SDL, Xvfb, the 48K ROM, Python 3, Pillow and python-xlib. The second part has its own listing and game notes in the matching second-program folder. We did not build a native executable.

Original source SHA-256:
DungeonFinal.tzx 9ddc81c80403a42fb486ce27200997e50da40fb71aa0c694e9685948368cfbd5
